exclude._note: tasks whose environment cannot run on this aarch64 host: amd64-only base images (claude-code installer aborts under qemu), a conda post-link failure, a GPU requirement; xrd-multiphase-qpa: pymatgen 2024.8.9 has no aarch64 wheel and the slim image has no gcc; edna-mifish-community: tests/runs data was never committed upstream (upstream .gitignore excludes 'runs'), so the verifier image cannot build; cad-model: verifier needs cascadio, which ships no linux-aarch64 wheel; freecad-* tasks: micromamba freecad install fails on this host (gdk-pixbuf post-link)

sample._source_root_note: empty on purpose: the full upstream benchmark copies are NOT in this repository. benchmarks/<benchmark>/ already holds the sampled subset and _meta.json records the seed, the source commit and the original paths. To resample, point sample.source_override.<benchmark> at your own upstream checkout.

researcher._search_script_note: serper through the gateway; authenticates with the container's own ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and holds no secret of its own. Was accidentally left empty until 2026-09-10, so the researcher had web permission but no search tool in runs 20260909-003117 / 20260909-235203 / 20260910-125300 and used none.

score._quality_coverage_target_note: the fraction of the rubric's failure modes that counts as full quality: quality = min(1, covered / ceil(a * scoreable_modes)). 1.0 is the plain fraction. Set below 1 because one new task cannot stage every mode of the task it was built from without being that task -- in run 20260909-003117 every episode that reached full coverage was also gated as a clone. At 0.6 with the usual 5-mode rubric, 3 exercised modes score 1.0.
score._format_note: format is measured by the judge and recorded in score.json, but does not enter the score: score = gate * difficulty * quality. Across in-band deliveries it concentrates between 0.75 and 1.0, too narrow at any sensible weight to separate agents, and a delivery that fails the checks badly enough is caught by the gate instead.

_claude_code_version_note: pin the claude-code release: harbor installs it per container from bootstrap.sh with no version, and 2.1.265 (published 2026-09-09 06:31) installs without putting claude on PATH, killing every run started after that minute
